name: dsh-token-wall
description: Token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: a block wall where each block is 10M tokens, spend breakdown by workspace / model / vendor, and a draggable floating pet.
author: The dsh-token-wall Authors

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:client && npm run test:host
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/fold.test.mjs && node --test test/blocks.test.mjs && node --test test/prefs.test.mjs && node --test test/models.test.mjs && node --test test/adapter.test.mjs && node --test test/store.retention.test.mjs
scripts.test:client: node test/client.smoke.mjs && node test/odometer.text.mjs && node test/sparkline.test.mjs && node test/blocks-cross.test.mjs && node test/distribution.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/fold.js && node --check lib/store.js && node --check lib/collect.js && node --check lib/adapter.js && node --check lib/blocks.js && node --check lib/models.js && node --check lib/prefs.js && node --check tools/check-stray-backticks.mjs && node tools/check-stray-backticks.mjs index.js client.js tools/visual-check.mjs

meta.title: Token 用量
meta.description: 按本机时区统计每次模型调用的 token 消耗，支持历史回填、任意区间汇总，以及每 10M 一格的方块墙。
